title: Nike previews new Kobe NXT shoes at Mamba Invitational event
text:
Nike previews new Kobe NXT shoes at Mamba Invitational event
The fourth annual Mamba Invitational began with a media preview of the “Chick Hearn Experience” at L.A. Live, featuring an immersive gallery that showcased the Nike Kobe signature line through mixed media installations on Aug. 12.
The exhibit included a mural celebrating key moments from Kobe Bryant’s Lakers career, a digital display of Protro shoe releases, and a 3D sculpture highlighting outsole designs from signature Kobe shoes. A previously unseen outsole from the Kobe line was also displayed in the installation. Artist Troy Murray said in a statement, “The Nike and Kobe team tasked me with creating a piece that storytells obsession to detail. I casted outsoles of his iconic shoes to reveal the precision that goes into every Kobe.”
Nike offered an initial look at an upcoming Kobe release during the event. The shoe is among the final projects Bryant was involved in before his death. Dan Sunwoo, vice president and general manager for the Kobe brand, said, “Kobe started this project. We’re committed to carrying it forward to the finish. More details soon.” Sunwoo continued, “We’re working on launching the first unfinished project we started with Kobe. We are revisiting the prototypes we worked on together and will advance a legacy defined by a shared belief in the infinite pursuit of better.”
According to KicksFinder, multiple versions of what is believed to be called the Nike Kobe NXT are expected for release during summer 2027. The Nike Kobe NXT Prototype is anticipated to retail for $410 while another version called Nike Kobe NXT 1.0 will be available in several colorways for $210 each.
Colorways rumored for release include dark smoke grey/off white/black/bright crimson; purple venom/black-white-infite/lilac-bright crimson; and lemon venom/white/black/albaster/bright crimson combinations. As of now, Nike has not officially released images or confirmed full details about either model.
The 'NXT' name first appeared on post-retirement models such as Nike Kobe NXT 360, Kobe A.D. NXT and AD NXT FF models—the latter debuting in August 2024 with FastFit, QuadFit and REACT technology.
